live_formula: value=units*price (long) else value_close; unreal=value-cost; unreal_pct=value/cost-1; net_if_sold=units*price*(1-fee)-cost; bh=alloc*price/bh_c0; balance=pool.cash+sum(value) (pool sizing) else sum(value)
